name: MALAKOF
recent: Malakoff 近期主要围绕电厂恢复运营与清洁能源转型展开：Lumut 与 GB3 电厂已恢复运作，其中 GB3 电厂提前三个月重启。同时，公司持续进行与 MMC Engineering 的关联交易，并有多家机构股东（Urusharta Jamaah、EPF、KWAP）的持股变动申报。
notable: 子公司 Sungai Udang WTE 与关联方 MMC Engineering 签署输电与互联工程协议（TIWA），涉及连接马六甲 Sungai Udang 垃圾转能源设施至 TNB PMU Cheng 的 33kV 输电工程。
429MW 的 Lumut 燃气电厂（GB3）提前三个月恢复运营。
多家机构股东（Urusharta Jamaah、EPF、KWAP）在近期持续申报持股变动。
risks: 公司与关联方 MMC Engineering 的经常性关联交易（RRPT）累计金额已超过 1% 比率门槛。
最新季度净利同比下滑 49.5%，净利率仅 1.7%。

recent_en: Malakoff has recently focused on plant restorations and clean energy transition: the Lumut and GB3 plants have resumed operations, with GB3 restarted three months ahead of schedule. Meanwhile, the company continues related party transactions with MMC Engineering and has seen shareholding changes reported by institutional shareholders (Urusharta Jamaah, EPF, KWAP).
notable_en: Subsidiary Sungai Udang WTE signed a Transmission and Interconnection Works Agreement (TIWA) with related party MMC Engineering for 33kV transmission works connecting the Sungai Udang waste-to-energy facility in Melaka to TNB's PMU Cheng.
The 429MW Lumut gas power plant (GB3) resumed operations three months ahead of schedule.
Several institutional shareholders (Urusharta Jamaah, EPF, KWAP) have continued to report changes in their shareholdings recently.
risks_en: The cumulative value of recurrent related party transactions (RRPT) with related party MMC Engineering has exceeded the 1% percentage ratio threshold.
Latest quarterly net profit fell 49.5% year-on-year, with a net margin of only 1.7%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1,910,173,000, up 39.1% QoQ but down 5.4% YoY; net profit was MYR 31,708,000, up 57.6% QoQ but down 49.5% YoY, with a net margin of 1.7%.
